content: Hi, I am 15 years old and really passionate about math and astronomy. For the past few months, I have been trying to solve a proof for the Legendre's conjecture and also managed to write a verification for it in Lean 4. I have saved my codes to my GitHub repository and I would like to share it. I am looking for some guidance on what to do next, and I would be really happy if anyone could take a look at the proof to spot any gaps or errors so I can fix them. Please see the lean file as it says, "goals accomplished" till now.

https://github.com/arnav-pandey7/github.git

Thank You Jeremy Chen to clarify all the gaps and errors I had when I asked through direct message. Thank you again for your invaluable insights and time you took for looking through my proof.
